stops.note: literally "burned liquor"; Korean soju is a Sino-Korean reading of this term (an older compound, arasoju, briefly added an Arabic-derived prefix referencing the distillation technique, but that prefix was later dropped)
Sino-Korean reading of 燒酒, Korea's clear distilled spirit
Chamisul is the world's best-selling liquor brand by volume

current_meaning: a clear, mildly alcoholic distilled spirit from Korea
